paragraph: There **must** be a better way to do this. They **must** be waiting for us. What's the time? You **must** work hard in order not to fail.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا بدّ أنّ هناك طريقة أفضل لفعل هذا.

other.meaning: said about something that is very likely, probable, or certain to be true
The property of being stale or musty (noun)

paragraph: How many schools are there in your **city**? Which **city** are you going to visit first? I want to show you my beautiful **city**.
arabicDesc: مثال: كم مِن مدارسة في مدينتك؟

paragraph: Could you please **move** out of my way? They **move** from place to place. I'm going to **move** next month.
english: (transitive) to change the place of something
arabicDesc: مثال: هل يمكنك أن تفسح لي الطريق من فضلك؟

other.meaning: (intransitive) to change place or posture; to go

paragraph: Are you **sure** you don't need to do that? Are you **sure** that you want to go there? Are you **sure** you know how to do this?
english: certain in one's knowledge or belief
arabicDesc: مثال: هل أنت متأكد بأنك لست بحاجة فعل هذا؟

paragraph: You don't seem to know what's going to **happen**. Let's think about the worst that could **happen**. Who knows what might **happen** in the future?
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يَبدوا أَنَّكَ تَعرِفُ ما سَيَحصُل

paragraph: We made up our mind to come in any **case**. This rule can be applied to any **case**. The rule doesn't apply in this **case**.
arabicDesc: مثال: قررنا أن نأتي على أي حال.

paragraph: **Please** give him the message when he comes back. **Please** don't talk about me when I'm gone. Would you **please** tell me your name again?
english: interjection to make a polite request
arabicDesc: مثال: رجاءً أعطه الرسالة عندما يعود.

paragraph: It's the best way that you can **support** me. I want to thank everyone for their **support**. I will do it on condition that you **support** me.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه هي أفضل طريقة تساعدني بها.

other.meaning: to back a cause, party, etc., mentally or with concrete aid

paragraph: **Let** us know if you aren't going to come. If you need some help with that, **let** me know. You must **let** things take their own course.
english: to allow to, not to prevent (+ infinitive, but usually without to)
arabicDesc: مثال: أخبرنا أن كنت لا تريد أن تأتي.

paragraph: Where are the bills you want me to **pay**? Of course you have to **pay**. What did you think? I'll do it if they **pay** me.
english: to give money in exchange for goods or services
arabicDesc: مثال: أين هي الفواتير التي تريد أن أدفعها؟

other.meaning: Money given in return for work (noun)

paragraph: I've come to like the picture more than **ever**. This is the worst movie I have **ever** seen. I'm trying my best to forget that **ever** happened.
arabicDesc: مثال: بدأت أحب الصورة أكثر من أي وقت مضى.

paragraph: Your mother **might** tell you who your father is. It **might** be best for me to leave. Since you're here, we **might** as well begin.
english: power, strength, force, or influence held by a person or group
arabicDesc: مثال: أنت لا تعرف حتى من هو أبوك.

paragraph: This story is **based** on a true story. How many of you are there at the **base**? Hitting the ball hard, he ran to first **base**.
english: something from which other things extend
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه القصة مُستمّدة من قصّةٍ واقعية.

other.meaning: 8. chemical compound that will neutralize an acid
To give as its foundation or starting point (verb)

paragraph: I'm controlling myself so as not to **lose** my head. Don't challenge someone who has nothing to **lose**. We are going to **lose** our jobs.
english: cease to have in one's possession or capability
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا متحكم في نفسي كي لا أفقد صوابي.

paragraph: Where do you **hold** your meetings? Would you please **hold** on? May I **hold** your hand?
arabicDesc: مثال: أين تجتمعون؟

paragraph: I think you **thought** what I'm going to think. I **thought** you didn't know how to do anything. I **thought** we weren't going to go there.
arabicDesc: مثال: أعتقد أنكَ فكرتَ في ما كنتُ سأفكر فيه.

paragraph: We have to **stop** this before it happens. When will we **stop** sitting by and watching? If you don't **stop**, I'll tell your mother.
arabicDesc: مثال: علينا أن نوقف هذا قبل أن يحدث.

other.meaning: to cause to cease moving — see also detain
not to continue — see also cease, desist
A (usually marked) place where buses, trams or trains halt to let passengers get on and off, usually smaller than a station (noun)

paragraph: Why did she **turn** off the light? Make sure to **turn** off all the lights before going out. Why did you **turn** down his offer?
english: to make a non-linear physical movement
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا أطفأت الضوء؟

other.meaning: position something by folding it back on itself, or using its folds
A change of direction or orientation (noun)

paragraph: What are you going to do with this **money**? I'm trying to find a way to make **money**. I gave her all the **money** I had.
english: means of exchange and measure of value
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا ستفعل بهذا المال؟

paragraph: What do you do in your **free** time? You are **free** to talk with anyone. You are **free** to go out.
arabicDesc: مثال: ما الذي تفعله بوقت فراغك؟

paragraph: This video is not available in your **country**. Don't open this letter until you're out of the **country**. He gave his life for his **country**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا الفيديو غير متوفر في بلدك.

other.meaning: the country, rural area, as opposed to the town or city

paragraph: Do you remember the **night** when we first met? What time did you go to bed last **night**? She called me up very late last **night**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تذكر الليلة التي تقابلنا فيها أول مرة؟

other.meaning: evening or night spent at a particular activity

paragraph: I can't get that song out of my **head**. How long ago did you hit your **head**? You're only hearing that voice in your **head**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يمكنني أن أنسى هذه الأغنية.

other.meaning: To be in command of. (See also head up.) (verb)

paragraph: Do you want me to give you a **hand**? I felt as if a cold **hand** was touching me. What do you have in your **hand**?
arabicDesc: مثال: أتود أن أساعدك؟

other.meaning: index or pointer on a dial, such as on an analogue/analog clock
servant, laborer, workman, trained for special duty; a performer

paragraph: The police were looking for a **lead**. This road **leads** you to the station. What **led** them to do that?
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت الشّرطة تبحث عن خطّ تحقيق.

paragraph: Must you go to the **post** office? I now work at the **post** office. We always walk by the **post** office on the way to work.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل يجب أن تذهب إلى مكتب البريد؟

other.meaning: individual message in a forum — see also upload
To travel with relays of horses (verb)

paragraph: The water in this **area** isn't good. It's a nice **area** to live in. The **area** was covered in trees.
arabicDesc: مثال: الماء في هذه المنطقة ليس صالحا.

paragraph: Did you find the **book** you were looking for? Which **book** is older, this one or that one? Do you know which **book** she wants to read?
english: collection of sheets of paper bound together containing printed or written material
arabicDesc: مثال: أوجدت الكتاب الذي كنت تبحث عنه؟

other.meaning: major division of a published work, larger than a chapter

paragraph: In **order** to do that, you have to take risks. Bill got up early in **order** to catch the first train. Can you **order** one for me?
english: request for some product or service
arabicDesc: مثال: لفعل ذلك، يجِبُ أن تُخاطر.

paragraph: I **hear** you, but I don't see you. You'll stay out of it. You **hear** me? Sorry, but I can't **hear** you very well.
arabicDesc: مثال: أسمعك لكنني لا أراك.

paragraph: I have to find **someone** to help me. Have you ever loved **someone** who never loved you back? Does **someone** here know how to do this?
arabicDesc: مثال: علي أن أجد أحدا لمساعدتي.

paragraph: I have to talk with her about the new **plan**. He made up his mind to keep his **plan** secret. Have you thought of a good **plan**?
english: set of intended actions — see also project
arabicDesc: مثال: لا بد لي من التحدث معها حول الخطة الجديدة.

paragraph: You filed a **report** with me a couple of weeks ago. Have you turned in your **report**? Take a look at this **report**.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنتَ قَدَمتَ تقريراً معي قبل إسبوعين.

paragraph: Don't **bring** your work problems home with you. **Bring** me those things I've asked for. Nothing can **bring** her back to life.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تحضر مشاكلك في العمل إلى المنزل.

paragraph: I don't **believe** I know where that is. I **believe** that there are other ways. You won't **believe** what she told me!
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أعتقد أنّني أعرف هذا المكان.

other.meaning: to have religious faith; to believe in a greater truth

paragraph: I've decided to stay for a **few** more days. The others will arrive in a **few** minutes. He asked a **few** questions of me.
arabicDesc: مثال: قرّرتُ البقاء لبضعة أيام أُخر.

paragraph: She went to the back of the **line**. His words don't **line** up with his actions. He drew a straight **line** on the wall.
arabicDesc: مثال: وقفت في آخر الصف.

other.meaning: path through two or more points, threadlike mark
single horizontal row of text on a screen, printed paper, etc.

paragraph: Do I have to do it right **away**? You had better stay **away** from work today. We are going to check it right **away**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل يجب أن أفعل ذلك الآن؟

paragraph: I **left** the rest to him and went out. I got to my feet and **left** the room. I **left** a note by your door this morning.
english: west side of the body when one is facing north
arabicDesc: مثال: تركت له الباقي وخرجت.

other.meaning: pertaining to the political left — see also leftist

paragraph: You are all I **care** about in life. I don't **care** how much money you have. Why do girls **care** so much about what guys think?
arabicDesc: مثال: أنتِ كلّ ما يهمُّني في الحياة.

paragraph: It was easy for her to find a **job**. I don't think he is fit for the **job**. I had my **job** interview in the meeting room.
english: economic role for which a person is paid
arabicDesc: مثال: كان سهلا عليها إيجاد عمل.

other.meaning: A book of the Old Testament and the Hebrew Tanakh (noun)

paragraph: I'm looking forward to doing **business** with you. What I write is my **business**. I am on a **business** trip.
english: occupation, work or trade of a person
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا أتتطلع للعمل معك.

paragraph: Our orders are to stay here **until** further notice. I won't leave **until** you let me inside. Don't put off **until** tomorrow what you can do today.
arabicDesc: مثال: أُمرنا بالبقاء هنا حتى إشعار آخر.

other.meaning: Up to the time that (a condition becomes true) (conjunction)

paragraph: She didn't know what to do with the **problem**. I found the **problem** easier than I had expected. What he says has nothing to do with this **problem**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لم تعرف كيف تتصرف تجاه المشكلة.

paragraph: I have been waiting for almost half an **hour**. The man kept talking for an **hour**. I talked with her for an **hour**.
arabicDesc: مثال: انتظرت قرابة النصف ساعة.

paragraph: You have to wait for one **month** at least. I read at least one book every **month**. January is the first **month** of the year.
english: period into which a year is divided
arabicDesc: مثال: عيلك الانتظار لشهر على الأقل.

paragraph: Let's turn the **power** back on. The old don't want to let go of **power**. I'll help you to the best of my **power**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لنسغل الطاقة مجددا.

paragraph: In that country the **government** controls prices. This is a **government** project. We believe in **government** by and for the people.
english: body with the power to make and/or enforce laws
arabicDesc: مثال: في تلك الدولة الحكومة تتحكم بالاسعار.

paragraph: Most of the hotels are **open** all year round. It took me several hours to **open** it. I don't want to leave the door **open**.
arabicDesc: مثال: أغلبية الفنادق مفتوحة طوال العام.

paragraph: What's the **real** reason you don't want to do this? He doesn't know if that tree is **real**. Why don't you get a **real** job?
arabicDesc: مثال: ما هو السبب الحقيقي لعدم رغبتك بعمل هذا؟

other.meaning: Former unit of currency of Spain and Spain's colonies (noun)
A unit of currency used in Brazil since 1994. Symbol: R$ (noun)

paragraph: He was able to build a **small** house. You may take either the big box or the **small** one. My brother is **small** but strong.
arabicDesc: مثال: استطاع أن يبني بيتاً صغيراً.

paragraph: She said she was a child of the **gods**. There is nothing that the **gods** may not do. You can't believe in **gods** you don't know.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: رب

other.meaning: person in high position of authority
The first deity of various theistic religions, and the only deity in monotheism (noun)

paragraph: He set one right on **top** of the other. He had to work his way to the **top**. I don't know off the **top** of my head.
Your house is three times as **large** as mine. He has a **large** family to support. The United States is a **large** country.
english: of greater size — see also big
arabicDesc: مثال: بيتك أكبر من بيتي ثلاث مرات.

paragraph: Do you know if he's coming to the **party**? You look like you're going out to a **party**. When was the last time you threw a **party**?
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعرف إن كان سيحضر الحفل؟

other.meaning: group of people forming one side in a given dispute, contest etc.

paragraph: What time does your **watch** say it is now? I'm sorry I don't have my **watch** with me. He was given a gold **watch** by the teacher.
english: to look at for a period of time
arabicDesc: مثال: ما الوقت الذي تشير إليه ساعتك الآن؟

paragraph: Do you have a **different** opinion? I think **different** from you. He asked a **different** teacher.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل عندك رأي مختلف؟

paragraph: Your success is the result of your **hard** work. When he was young, he was a **hard** worker. In **hard** times, you find out who your friends are.
english: requiring a lot of effort to do or understand
arabicDesc: مثال: نجاحك يعود لاجتهادك في عملك.

paragraph: She was the one **girl** who actually loved me. This is the boy who looks like a **girl**. Can I tell you that you're a beautiful **girl**?
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت الفتاة الوحيدة التي كانت تحبني حقا

paragraph: Smoking can **kill** you, so please try to stop.
english: to cause a person, animal or plant to die
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: موت، ذبح

other.meaning: to cause a person, animal or plant to die (noun)

paragraph: I called you in here to ask you a **question**. The **question** is where to buy the book. What a **question**! Of course I love him.
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد دعوتك إلی هنا لأسألك سؤالا

other.meaning: subject or topic — see also topic

paragraph: She doesn't want me to speak about this **issue**. We should face up to this **issue**. It's not his ability, but his character that is at **issue**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هي لا تريد مني التحدث عن هذه المسألة.

other.meaning: a single edition of a periodical publication

paragraph: How can you say that to my **face**? I remember his **face** but I can't remember his name. He kept his eyes fixed on her **face**.
english: the front part of the head of a human or other animal, featuring the eyes, nose, and mouth, and the surrounding area
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف تجرؤ أن تقول لي هذا في وجهي؟

other.meaning: public image — see also image, reputation
To position oneself or itself so as to have one's face closest to (something) (verb)

paragraph: What kind of **person** do you want to be? I just want to be a good **person**. I think you are a really nice **person**.
arabicDesc: مثال: أي نوع من الناس تريد أن تكون؟

other.meaning: specifically a human being — see also human, human being, man
the physical body seen as distinct from the mind

paragraph: The children are on the left **side** of the house. But there is another **side** to the story. Who was that on the other **side**?
english: bounding straight edge of an object
arabicDesc: مثال: الأطفال في جانب البيت الأيسر.

other.meaning: surface of a sheet of paper

paragraph: Let's see each other again. Just not now, **however**. I know him, **however**, I don't know his name. **However** you look at it, it's a bad business.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: على كل حال

paragraph: No. I'm sorry, I've got to go back **early**. Some women know what they want from an **early** age. Why did you go to sleep so **early** last night?
arabicDesc: مثال: لا. أنا آسف، عليّ العودة مبكراً.

paragraph: How do you know that that was the **cause**? I believe this man to be a lost **cause**. Are not you the **cause** of this for me?
english: source or reason of an event or action

other.meaning: To set off an event or action (verb)

paragraph: If you don't like it then you can **leave**. We don't know why he had to **leave**. If you want to **leave**, then **leave** now!
arabicDesc: مثال: إن لم يعجبك فبإمكانك أن تتركه.

other.meaning: to depart from, end one's connection or affiliation with

paragraph: I'm not a **member** of the club. In Europe and America they regard the dog as a **member** of the family. My friend became like a **member** of my family.
english: one who officially belongs to a group
arabicDesc: مثال: انا لست عضوا بالنادي.

paragraph: What does she think about the conference **results**? We have to get **results**. Can you tell me when I can have the **results** of the test?
arabicDesc: مثال: ما رأيها بنتيجة المؤتمر؟

paragraph: Is there a **public** phone around here? There are some things you don't say in **public**. Did that happen to you in a **public** place?
english: open to all members of a community, as opposed to only a segment of it
arabicDesc: مثال: هل هناك هاتف عمومي في هذه المنطقة؟

other.meaning: pertaining to people as a whole, as opposed to a group of people
Chiefly preceded by the: members of the community or the people in general, regardless of membership of any particular group (noun)

paragraph: There was no one I could tell my **story** to. Tell a beautiful **story** to my young friend. You will have heard this **story** before.
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أجد أحدا كنت أستطيع أن أروي له قصّتي.

paragraph: I **hope** to effect positive change in the world. I **hope** you don't forget to do that. I **hope** that all your dreams come true.
english: to want something to happen, with expectation that it might
arabicDesc: مثال: آمل أن أُحدث تغييرا إيجابيا على العالم.

other.meaning: The feeling of trust, confidence, belief or expectation that something wished for can or will happen (noun)

paragraph: I know my brother-in-**law**. She's not breaking the **law**. I didn't know that you went to **law** school.
english: body of rules established in a community by its authorities
arabicDesc: مثال: أعرف نسيبي.

other.meaning: any rule that must or should be obeyed

paragraph: You probably don't understand a **word** I'm saying today. I don't understand the meaning of this **word**. May I have a **word** with you?
arabicDesc: مثال: على الأرجح أنك لا تفهم أي كلمة مما أقوله اليوم.

paragraph: A well is a place where you can get **water**. If it were not for **water**, we could not live. We use a lot of **water** every day.
arabicDesc: مثال: البئر هو مكان تحصل فيه على الماء.

other.meaning: body of water, or specific part of it
To wet or supply with water (verb)

paragraph: I don't have the time to **read** that book. We must **read** this book again and again. This book is hard for me to **read**.
english: to look at and interpret letters or other information
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أملك الوقت الكافي لقراءة هذا الكتاب

paragraph: I will not forget to **write** to my mother. Please **write** down what I'm going to say. Are you saying that you didn't **write** this?
arabicDesc: مثال: لن أنس مراسلة أمّي.

paragraph: You don't **seem** too happy to see me. There don't **seem** to be any problems. You don't **seem** to care what happens.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تبدو سعيدا جدا لرؤيتي.

paragraph: Please will you **close** the door when you go out. Did you remember to **close** all the windows? How many **close** friends do you have?
arabicDesc: مثال: الرجاء إغلاق الباب عند الخروج.

other.meaning: Having little difference or distance in place, position, or abstractly (adjective)

paragraph: I guess I could **wait** a little bit longer. I can **wait** four days at the longest. I will **wait** for you in front of the school.
arabicDesc: مثال: أظن أنني يمكنني الانتظار أكثر قليلا.

paragraph: She **provided** me with some food. They had a lot of children to **provide** for. Can you please **provide** us with a phone number?
arabicDesc: مثال: هي قدمت لي بعض الطعام.

paragraph: It's time for you to buy a new **car**. He said that he had bought a used **car**. I do not know how to drive a **car**.
english: automobile, a vehicle steered by a driver
arabicDesc: مثال: حان الوقت لأن تشتري سيارة جديدة.

paragraph: Do you have a lot to do **today**? Did you know they were coming here **today**? Why didn't you tell me there was a meeting **today**?
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لديك الكثير لتفعله اليوم؟

other.meaning: nowadays — see also nowadays, these days, currently

paragraph: The water **level** was low. They wanted to take things to the next **level**. You're not old enough to be at that **level**.
english: distance relative to a given reference elevation
arabicDesc: مثال: كان مستوى الماء منخفضا.

paragraph: It's **nothing** compared to what he did to me. Is there **nothing** you want to tell me? I have **nothing** to do with the matter.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا لا يُقارن بما فعله معي.

paragraph: How much is the car that you're planning to **buy**? How much could I **buy** this house for? I lost my watch, so I have to **buy** one.
arabicDesc: مثال: كم ثمن السيارة اللتي تنوي أن تشتريها؟

paragraph: Have you heard **already** that he has finally returned home? I **already** told you he isn't here. You may have read this book **already**.
arabicDesc: مثال: أسمعت أنه قد عاد أخيرا إلى بيته؟

paragraph: Is there **anything** that you want to tell me? It really doesn't have **anything** to do with you. I don't see **anything** wrong with what you're doing.
arabicDesc: مثال: أثمّة ما تريد إخباري عنه؟

paragraph: His father is a football **player**. That team has strong **players**. Don't ever tell me I'm not a team **player**.
english: one who plays any game or sport
arabicDesc: مثال: أبوه لاعب كرة قدم.

paragraph: I entered the room, which was **full** of people. I worked for a **full** 24 hours without getting any sleep. I don't want a **full**-time job.
arabicDesc: مثال: دخلتُ الغرفة التي كانت مليئة بالناس.

paragraph: The **force** of the wind made it difficult to walk. **Force** is the only language they understand. They will be back in **force**.
arabicDesc: مثال: قوة الريح جعلت المشي صعباً.

other.meaning: To make someone or something do something, often regardless of their will (verb)

paragraph: I don't think we have **enough** time to do that. We don't have **enough** money to buy everything we need. I didn't do **enough** research for this book.
english: stop! Don't do that any more! It is too much!
arabicDesc: مثال: لا اعتقد اننا نملك الوقت الكافي لفعل ذلك.

paragraph: I want you to tell me **everything** that happened. She talks as if she knew **everything** about it. You shouldn't give your kids **everything** they want.
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن تروي لي كلّ ما حدث.

paragraph: We haven't finished what we have to do **yet**. Don't give up **yet**. I'm sure you can do it. We haven't had those kinds of problems **yet**.
english: not as of the time referenced
